image-placeholder.title: Image Placeholder
image-placeholder.description: A Notion-style image placeholder node that lets you upload or embed an image by URL, with a resizable image node view and its own toolbar button.

table.title: Table
table.description: A table node with a toolbar that inserts tables from a grid-size picker and lets you add or delete rows and columns, merge and split cells, and toggle the header row.

highlight.title: Highlight Color
highlight.description: The multicolor highlight mark with a toolbar that applies a color from a popover palette and removes existing highlights.
